text:
alex: Heads up — planning to enable cross-region circuit-breaker flag (flag: cross_region_cb) tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:00 PT for EU->NA fallback. Intention: trip early to avoid cascading NA overload and route to local model variant. Need quick checklist & owners.

maria_s: +1. Are we doing a percentage ramp or immediate gate?

alex: Start 5% traffic for 30m canary, then 25% for 1h, then 100% if stable. Rollback plan: disable flag -> traffic back to default. Runbook: /runbooks/cross-region-cb (link).

samir: Who owns the app-side monitors? I can watch infra metrics but need someone to own error% and p95.

katie: I can own app metrics (error% and latency p95). Dashboards: https://dash.redwood.example/cross-region-cb. Alert thresholds: errors >1% for 15m OR p95 increase >200ms.

devops-bot: deploy started: infra-proxy v2.3.1 -> EU at 08:45 PT. :white_check_mark:

ryan: Note about client affinity: if we change routing we should disable stickiness during canary. Flag supports param sticky=false.

alex: Good call — sticky=false for canary. Adding rollout config snippet below.

alex: ```
flag: cross_region_cb
params:
  scope: EU
  fallback_target: NA_model_v2 -> local_model_v1
  percent: 5
  sticky: false
  ttl: 10m
```

katie: @alex quick question on KV cache: if clients keep KV-prefetch for NA_model_v2 and then get local_model_v1, we might serve divergent generations. Consider invalidation or header to signal fallback.

alex: We'll emit X-Model-Fallback header and backend will invalidate KV for clients when header present. Samir, can you add telemetry?

samir: added telemetry event model.fallback.triggered (count + last_kv_seq) — hooking into Datadog. Also adding a histogram for fallback latency.

oncall-jen: I'll be on rotation 08:30-11:30 PT and can jump if latency or error alerts fire.

maria_s: Quick CR ping — small route logic change in PR #456. Need infra approval before merge.

ryan: reviewing now. Please add a unit test for stickiness=false behavior.

katie: Let's schedule a smoke window at 09:40 PT after the first ramp to run synthetic checks from EU vantage points.

alex: Proposed timeline: 09:00 start 5% canary, 09:30 increase to 25% if green, 09:40 smoke window, 10:30 -> 100% if green. Rollback immediate if alerts hit thresholds.

maria_s: noted, I'll monitor logs and keep PR ready to revert if needed.

alex: tagging @oncall-jen @katie @samir @ryan — ping here if anything unexpected. :thumbsup:

samir: one more ask — export circuit-breaker metric to SLO dashboard so product SRE sees impact in daily report.

alex: will update rollout doc after merge and add postmortem checklist. Thanks all.
